study: C1c converged SSCHA, start A vs B (R1.4)

recipe.seed_rule: np.random.seed(seed + index of start), A=0, B=1

start_construction.rule: ForcePositiveDefinite construction with every imaginary non-acoustic mode set to +0.3 THz instead of |w|, + Symmetrize

semantics.converged: gc < meaningful_factor * gc_err AND gw < meaningful_factor * gw_err (or < abs_conv_thr), gradi_op 'all' (SchaMinimizer.py:1622-1651). gc_err is the library's serial stochastic error (module_stochastic.f90:270-274), not the parallel wrapper's placeholder (Ensemble.py:2657); it is set to zero where KL/N at the gradient is below converge_min_kl_ratio, so convergence cannot be declared at a statistically invalid point. Its scale is the Fourier transform of the real-space error matrix (coherent at Gamma), divided by sqrt(nsym*nq) (:456): a 1/sqrt(N_eff) noise scale, not a calibrated z-score. The structures here have no free Wyckoff parameter, so gw is zero by symmetry and the test reduces to gc
semantics.converged_dyn: a converged population is not restored (:1391), so the final dyn is one step past the gradient that passed; kl_ratio_at_end is the KL after it
semantics.population_end: converged, KL/N < kong_liu_ratio on a new direction (:1654-1661), or max_steps_per_pop steps (max_ka reset per population by the pre hook)
semantics.relax_end: a converged population (Relax.py:410-411), max_pop populations, or the wall-clock cap (the post hook ends the current population after one more step and sets max_pop so no new population is drawn, Relax.py:412-416)
semantics.restore: an unconverged population discards its last step (SchaMinimizer.py:1389-1397)
